description.value: You worked with stone in every way that matters: quarrying, shaping, fitting, mortaring. All meant to build things meant to outlast everyone involved in making them. The work was physical and geometrically demanding, and your eye for structural integrity developed from necessity rather than theory.

system.startingEquipment:
Common clothes
work gloves
work boots
system.features: Stonereader: You can assess the construction and condition of stone structures at a glance. In underground environments, you can identify worked stone versus natural formation, and estimate how recently a passage was cut.
